On the grid, draw the following lines: x = 1, y = 12 - 2x for 0 \leqslant x \leqslant 6, 4y + 3x = 36 for 0 \leqslant x \leqslant 12.

Find the minimum value of x + y in the region R.
Find the co-ordinates of the point corresponding to this minimum value.

Find the probability that both discs are red.
Find the probability that at least one disc is red.

Find the relative frequency of white cars, giving your answer as a fraction in its lowest terms.
